newsitem.title: USA: Boyd sees favorable qtly comparisons ahead.
newsitem.headline: Boyd sees favorable qtly comparisons ahead.

text.p: Boyd Gaming Corp, after reporting a third quarter $1.27 per share loss with charges on Thursday, said it expects earnings in the next few quarters to compare favorably to year ago results.

Boyd reported the fiscal third quarter loss including a $1.37 a share charge for its underperforming riverboat casino in Kansas City. On an operating basis, Boyd generated a net profit of $0.10 a share versus a profit of $0.20 a share.
"The company expects...to have favorable year-over-year income comparisons the remainder of the calendar year," William Boyd, chief executive, said in a statement.

"This is our second consecutive quarter of $0.10 per share earnings before preopening, extraordinary and one-time charges, following two poor operating quarters in the middle of calendar 1996," Boyd said.
"We feel we've stabilized our quarterly income level for now, and, with a rededicated focus on our operations, can grow the business from its new base."
